description: Defines classes for redirecting console output and error streams, including StandardOut, StandardError, ConsoleStandardOut, and ConsoleStandardError, with methods for outputting messages and singleton access.

classes.name: StandardOut
classes.description: Handles output to standard output stream, with an Output method that sends messages if enabled.

classes.name: StandardError
classes.description: Handles output to standard error stream, with an Output method that sends messages if enabled.

classes.name: ConsoleStandardOut
classes.description: Singleton class that redirects core TextStream to StandardOut.

classes.name: ConsoleStandardError
classes.description: Singleton class that redirects core TextStream to StandardError.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs a message buffer of given length to the respective stream if enabled.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of ConsoleStandardOut or ConsoleStandardError.
